function.name: api_request_tool
function.description: Find open appointment start times on a given weekday for a specific service. Appointment lengths vary by service, so availability depends on which one. Call this before naming ANY time to the caller, including alternatives.

messages.content: One moment while I check the schedule.

service.description: Service name or key from getServices, e.g. {{CONSULT_SERVICE_KEY}}.

expectedWeekday.description: The weekday you believe this date falls on, e.g. Wednesday. Always include it.
